description: Create a canonical chapter record through the explicit structure workflow. Writes canonical chapter state only; it does not create scene files, sidecars, or Scrivener-compatible folders. Use assign_scene_to_chapter afterward to place unchaptered scenes in the new chapter.

chapter_id.description: Optional canonical chapter identifier. If omitted, one is derived from sort_index and title.

sort_index.description: Canonical chapter order within the project. Must be unused.

name: create_chapter
